manifest.name: dsh-oauth-openai
manifest.description: Provider subscription sign-in for DeepSeek Harness models settings

summary.zh-CN: 在模型设置页用提供商订阅（如 ChatGPT）登录，不需要 API 密钥。
summary.en: Sign in with a provider subscription (such as ChatGPT) from the Models settings page instead of an API key.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/verify-package.mjs

bundle.text:
# Subscription sign-in for the Models settings page. The Host half owns the
# authorization attempts; the Client half only renders the provider card seat.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-oauth-openai
      name: dsh-oauth-openai

readme.text:
English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> **Scope change.** DeepSeek Harness now owns the provider side: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`
> registers the OpenAI Codex OAuth flow, credential storage, refresh, and model routing
> through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`. What the product still lacks is a browser
> surface for that seam. This package is that surface, and nothing else.

A provider card extension for the Models settings page: it lets a person sign in with a
provider subscription (ChatGPT Plus/Pro, and any other flow the Host exposes for a
provider) instead of pasting an API key.

- A **Host** Remote namespace (`codexAuth`) that drives `ctx.authorization` for one
  browser surface: start an attempt, read its notices and prompts, answer, cancel.
- A **Client** registration on the `settings.models.provider-card` seat for the
  `llm-pi-ai` family. Cards whose provider reports `nativeAuth.oauth` get a
  "Sign in with …" button; every other card renders nothing.

It does not ship an OAuth driver, a model adapter, or credential storage. Those belong to
the provider plugin, and installing both would mean two owners for one credential.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.
- A provider plugin that registers an authorization flow, such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-oauth-openai
```

For a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-oauth-openai
```

Restart the profile, open **Settings → Models**, and add or edit a provider that offers a
subscription login.

```text
Settings → Models card (Client)
  └─ remote.codexAuth.start / state / answer / cancel
       └─ Host ProviderSignInController
            └─ ctx.authorization.begin({ key, method, signal, interaction })

The Host keeps one attempt per credential key, projects the seam's notices and prompts
into plain views, and retains a finished attempt for five minutes so a late poll still
sees its outcome. The Client polls `state` while an attempt runs; the stream is
deliberately not used, so the plugin needs no uplink support.

**Secrets never cross the wire.** The seam reports `authorized` only after the credential
is stored, and the views carry a message, a URL, a short code, and prompt text — never a
token or a credential record. Failures keep the seam's own sentence when the error is an
`AuthorizationError`, and collapse everything else to `authorization failed`.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # build the client bundle, run the controller tests, verify the package
```

`src/controller.js` is Host logic and runs under `node:test` with a fake seam.
`src/client.jsx` is bundled by `scripts/build.mjs` into `dist/client.js` in the
`window.__ModuleLoader__` wrapper the Web client expects.

- The card's copy is English only; the page's locale service is not wired yet.
- One card shows the first flow whose key matches `llm-pi-ai/<provider>`.
- Signing in does not refresh the card's own key state; reopen the card to see it.
MIT

[English](README.md) | 中文

> **范围变了。** DeepSeek Harness 已经接管了提供商这一侧：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`
> 通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization` 注册 OpenAI Codex 的 OAuth 流程、凭据存储、刷新和
> 模型路由。产品仍然缺的是这个 seam 的浏览器界面。这个包只做界面。

模型设置页的提供商卡片扩展：让人用提供商订阅（ChatGPT Plus/Pro，以及 Host 为该提供商暴露的
任何其他流程）登录，而不是粘贴 API 密钥。

- **Host** 侧一个 Remote 命名空间（`codexAuth`），为一个浏览器界面驱动 `ctx.authorization`：
  开始一次尝试、读取提示与通知、回答、取消。
- **Client** 侧在 `settings.models.provider-card` 座位上为 `llm-pi-ai` 家族注册。声明了
  `nativeAuth.oauth` 的提供商会看到“Sign in with …”按钮，其余卡片什么都不渲染。

它不带 OAuth 驱动、模型适配器或凭据存储。那些属于提供商插件；两边都装等于一份凭据两个主人。

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或更新版本。
- 一个注册了授权流程的提供商插件，例如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-oauth-openai
```

本地检出：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-oauth-openai
```

重启 profile，打开 **设置 → 模型**，添加或编辑一个支持订阅登录的提供商。

```text
模型设置卡片（Client）
  └─ remote.codexAuth.start / state / answer / cancel
       └─ Host ProviderSignInController
            └─ ctx.authorization.begin({ key, method, signal, interaction })

Host 为每个凭据键保留一次尝试，把 seam 的通知和提示投影成普通视图，并在完成后保留五分钟，
让晚到的轮询仍能看到结果。Client 在尝试运行期间轮询 `state`，刻意不用流式，这样插件不需要
上行支持。

**密钥不过线。** seam 只有在凭据写入后才报告 `authorized`；视图里只有消息、URL、短代码和
提示文本，没有 token，也没有凭据记录。失败时，`AuthorizationError` 保留 seam 自己的句子，
其他错误统一收敛为 `authorization failed`。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # 构建客户端包、跑控制器测试、校验打包
```

`src/controller.js` 是 Host 逻辑，用 `node:test` 对着假 seam 运行。`src/client.jsx` 由
`scripts/build.mjs` 打包成 `dist/client.js`，带 Web 客户端要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 包装。

- 卡片文案只有英文，尚未接入页面语言服务。
- 一张卡片只显示键匹配 `llm-pi-ai/<provider>` 的第一个流程。
- 登录成功后卡片自身的密钥状态不会自动刷新，重新打开卡片才能看到。
MIT
